meta.title: Junior Leaders Academy | Private school in Deroua
meta.description: Private preschool and primary school in Deroua (Nouaceur). Arabic, French and English. Enrollment open for 2026-2027. 06 61 10 75 11.
meta.careersDescription: Junior Leaders Academy is hiring preschool and primary teachers in Deroua. At least 3 years of experience.

hero.title: Where leaders begin their journey
hero.lead: Preschool and primary, in Arabic, French and English. A place to grow, speak up and try.

why.title: What the school nurtures, every day

items.title: Three languages, from the start
items.text: Arabic, French and English are part of the day, so each child can speak in all three.

items.title: Leadership, while they are small
items.text: Speaking up, helping a classmate, daring to try. The school motto lives in the classroom.

items.title: Confidence and creativity
items.text: Play, projects and the right to make mistakes are part of learning.

items.title: Moroccan roots
items.text: Civic values and Moroccan culture sit alongside languages and knowledge.

programs.title: From preschool to primary
programs.lead: Two cycles, one idea: a child at ease speaking, making and learning.
programs.preText: Language, movement, life in a group, and the first responsibilities. Children come to play, talk and grow confident.
programs.priText: Reading, writing, numbers, and understanding. Three languages support a solid base and real independence.

approach.title: Where Leaders Begin Their Journey
approach.text: A child who knows themselves, respects others, and wants to learn. That is the path the school opens from the first day.

photos.title: The school, in pictures
photos.lead: Class days, announcements and life at school.
photos.tea: Children preparing tea, in traditional dress
photos.igText: Announcements, class days and news from the school.
photos.fbText: Photos published on the school page.

items.title: Write to us
items.text: A WhatsApp message or the form. Tell us the age or grade, and your neighbourhood if you need transport.

items.title: Come and see
items.text: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 to 18:30. Lotissement Al Tayssir, behind the Al Madina mosque.

items.title: We enroll together
items.text: Fees, transport and supplies are set with the administration, on site.

items.a: No. Tuition, transport and supplies are given by the administration at 06 61 10 75 11.
Preschool and the whole of primary.
Lotissement Al Tayssir, no. 01, behind the Al Madina mosque, Deroua, Nouaceur province.
Monday to Saturday, 9:00 to 18:30, for enrollment and visits.
